title: fagara hamiltoniana
intro: Fagara hamiltoniana, commonly known as Zanthoxylum hamiltonianum, is a species of plant in the rutaceae family, native to the Himalayas and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fagara hamiltoniana include pain relief, fever reduction, and the treatment of digestive issues. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
